title: 2023-2024 Retail Sales Performance Report
executive_summary: This report presents the verified findings from the analysis of retail sales data for the years 2023 and 2024. Key metrics include overall performance, regional differences, quarterly trends, year-over-year growth, high-discount electronics orders, and customer concentration. The analysis reveals a 10.08% year-over-year revenue growth, with the East region leading in revenue and a notable increase in quarterly revenue throughout 2024.

key_findings.statement: The overall performance for 2023-2024 shows a total revenue of $445,325.07 from 520 orders, with an average order value of $856.39.
Regional comparison indicates the East region had the highest revenue at $130,516.68, followed by North, South, and West.
The quarterly trend in 2024 shows a steady increase in revenue, with Q3 having the highest revenue at $71,674.98.
Year-over-year change shows a 10.08% increase in revenue from 2023 to 2024.
There were 22 high-discount electronics orders with a total revenue of $50,035.32.
The distribution of order revenue shows a mean of $856.39, a median of $313.28, and a standard deviation of $1,295.74.
The customer concentration analysis reveals 222 unique customers, with the top customer accounting for 6.24% of total revenue.

limitations: The analysis is based on the cleaned data, which may not capture all nuances of the raw data.
The year-over-year comparison does not account for seasonal variations or external market factors.
The customer concentration metric may be influenced by large orders from a few customers.
conclusion: The analysis provides a comprehensive view of the retail sales performance for 2023-2024, highlighting key trends and areas for further investigation. The steady revenue growth and regional performance insights are particularly valuable for strategic planning.
